note: Set A is better because it more accurately extracts the coordinates for the Neutral Axes and Shear Center (x3=0.0m), whereas Set B incorrectly assigns x3=0.05m to the Neutral Axes (confusing it with the Geometric/Mass Centers) and provides inconsistent values (0.05m and 0.02m). Set A also provides more precise estimates for the Mass and Geometric Center x2 coordinates (-0.15m/-0.2m) compared to Set B's -0.25m. Both sets correctly identify the materials and section location from the legend and title, but Set A has fewer hallucinated or inconsistent numerical values.
